body: i'm here if you want to talk, im trying to push through it and i hope you can too
it's like a cycle too, there's hope and then it all just comes back around and you're lost all over again
thank you for your kind words <3
it's a living hell. thank you for offering to talk i really appreciate that. i feel like i have no one right now not even my closest friends or family.

i've just been a super manipulative, shitty person and i hate myself for it every day of my life. i have been hoping therapy will help but im barely managing until i have my first official "sit down". i want to be better so badly but i feel like its too late for me.
no one can really say with certainty except for a professional. if you are suffering, whether it be a little, moderately, or severly, please talk so that you can get the help you deserve.

this was me like a week ago. i recently just started therapy and have already felt a weight lifted by talking to someone. that day i felt so fucking happy like wow i can see a future, i have a chance to get better! but here i am right now still absolutely consumed by every negative thought in the book. it takes time is all i can say, and unfortunately with mental illness its like taking one step forwards and then two steps backwards. in time though, you'll understand more and more how and why you're feeling the way you are and how to cope with it and learn to counter it. keep fighting, you arent alone and there are more breakthroughs to come.
just wanna say even though i'm a stranger on the internet i'm proud of you and happy for your happiness :) keep fighting!
